home.title: Your licence. Our delivery engine.
home.summary: Technical sub-consultancy for licensed UAE engineering and architectural consultants and contractors. You hold the licence, contract and client relationship. We support the technical delivery.

partner.title: Keep the client. Add delivery capacity.
partner.summary: Bring us a defined work package. Agree the responsibilities, review points and handover. Alanpire works behind your delivery team, under your firm's licence and contract.

about.title: A technical sub-consultant, not your competitor.
about.summary: Alanpire supports licensed UAE partners with technical work. Your firm retains the client relationship, professional responsibility and authority-facing role.

services.title: Technical capacity for your next work package.
services.summary: Agree the scope before work starts. We prepare technical input for your review; your licensed team controls issue, stamping and submissions.

projects.title: Team experience. Precisely attributed.
projects.summary: Separate the engineering team's prior work from Alanpire's UAE capability. Prior-team work is not a contract awarded to the UAE entity.

contact.title: Start with the package, not a sales pitch.
contact.summary: Tell us your firm's licence category, project type and timeline. Request an NDA before sharing confidential technical documents.

eyebrow: Technical delivery support for licensed UAE partners
problemTitle: Won the work. Need more capacity?
problem: Keep your core team focused on the client and decisions. Assign a defined technical package to a sub-consultant without handing over the client relationship.

steps.title: Define the package
steps.text: Share non-confidential scope, required outputs and target dates. Request an NDA before exchanging sensitive files.

steps.title: Set the responsibilities
steps.text: Agree the delivery boundary, review points, required standards and the licensed partner's responsibilities.

steps.title: Prepare and review
steps.text: We prepare technical input. Your team reviews it and directs revisions against the agreed scope.

steps.title: Hand over for partner issue
steps.text: Your licensed team controls final issue, stamping, authority submissions and the client handover.

doneTitle: What the engineering team has worked on
doneNote: Prior-team examples are being checked against the portfolio and attribution records before publication. They are not presented as UAE company contracts.
attribution: Experience of the engineering team through OOO Energodiagnostika. Not contracts awarded to the UAE entity.
possible: POSSIBLE · Capability, not past UAE work
possibleTitle: What your firm can scope with us

capabilities.title: Diagnostics and condition assessment support
capabilities.text: Technical review input and inspection or testing documentation, within a partner-defined scope.

capabilities.title: Technical documentation and design support
capabilities.text: Technical design support under the licensed partner's licence, including coordination and review packages.

capabilities.title: Heating, water networks and boiler houses
capabilities.text: Technical design support for district heating, water networks and boiler-house packages.

capabilities.title: Environmental studies support
capabilities.text: Baseline scoping, emissions calculations and construction environmental plans as agreed technical input.

authorityNote: Prepared as technical input; authority submissions are made by the licensed UAE partner.
accreditationNote: Work requiring UAE accreditation is subject to confirmation of the licensed partner's accreditation before acceptance.

benefits.title: Keep your client relationship
benefits.text: Your firm remains the contracting and client-facing party.

benefits.title: Define the workload
benefits.text: Agree deliverables and review gates instead of an open-ended staffing promise.

benefits.title: Retain technical decisions
benefits.text: Your licensed team reviews the input and decides what can be issued.

exclusions: We do not issue stamped or authority-approved documents.
We do not make municipal or authority submissions or obtain NOCs directly.
We do not claim that overseas registrations or experience confer UAE accreditation.
illustrative: Illustrative — not a project photograph or engineering drawing.
visualAlt: Illustrative technical diagram of an industrial utility network.

form.title: Start a partner discussion
form.intro: Use a non-confidential summary. An NDA request is not a signed NDA, and a document-exchange request does not upload files.
form.hint: Outline the outputs and review needs. Do not include client names, personal data or confidential files.
form.nda: Request an NDA before sharing files
form.consent: I agree to be contacted about this enquiry and have read the
form.success: Your enquiry was accepted by the form service. This does not confirm the scope, capacity or an NDA.
form.failure: We could not confirm acceptance. Your entries are still here. Try again or email the team.
form.fallback: Online submission is not available. Prepare an email enquiry instead; nothing is sent until you send it in your email app.
form.sendHint: You can request an NDA and capability brief without sharing project documents.
